PIN NUMBER RECEIVED!!! Liverpool here she comes!!! 🎉🎉🎉 @Lorna Villaruz my bestfriend, my sister from another mother, finally finally!!! Thank you Lord 🙏❤️ I am so happy I cannot even type properly. After all the papers, IELTS, CBT, OSCE and waiting waiting waiting, you are now officially a registered nurse in the UK!! So proud of you, day.

For 20 years I have been saying Lorna come here, come to Liverpool, what are you waiting for?? Haha. When I left for the UK in 2004 you cried at the airport and told me “susunod ako”, I will follow you. That was 22 years ago when you made that promise!! I know you said you will follow, you did not say you were taking the scenic route through Riyadh and Dubai 😂😂 But now we have a date and I can stop asking you every year!

She lands in Manchester from Dubai on 14 January 2027, around 1pm, then Liverpool we are ready for you!!! And on 25 January she starts on Ward 7, induction first then her preceptorship. Ward 7, you are so lucky to have her. Honestly she is the best nurse I know. So calm, so caring, the patients love her. Nearly 18 years working in Riyadh and Dubai, and now she is bringing all that experience here. I am already the proud friend telling everybody, yes that one is my batchmate 😘

From nursing school in Iloilo, our capping ceremony in 1996, to this!! Look at us now, Lorna. Same dream, just a few more years on the knees haha. I still remember us in the dorm polishing our white shoes every night. And when I say OUR polish I mean MY polish, because this woman always borrowed mine and never bought her own 😂 You can bring your own polish to Liverpool ha, I have supplied enough for one lifetime!

She did her OSCE in Nottingham and I sent her a photo of the rain, just so nobody can say I did not warn her. Please bring a proper coat, day. Not a little jacket because it looks nice in the airport photo. A proper coat!! Liverpool wind does not care that you have come from Dubai 😂 Thick duvet will be ready also, I am not having you freeze in our spare room.

You are staying with us for your first month, yes it is settled, Ben says yes too!! Although now you have promised dried mangoes and Bicol pili I think he will be checking your luggage before asking how your flight was haha.

To our Filipino family here, help me welcome my Lorna ❤️ You have heard me talking about her for years and now you will finally meet her. Next year you will be with us for the Christmas parties, the food, the laughing, and Simbang Gabi. No more just seeing the photos, day, you will be beside us!

Congratulations again my dear friend. Enjoy every minute of this happy day, you worked so hard for it. From our white shoes in Iloilo to winter boots in Liverpool!! Cannot wait to have you here. Love you, see you in January!!! 🎉🙏❤️
